message: I brought Miyako back to my dorm room.

name: Miyako
message: 「...So this is Sis’s room？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Y-Yeah, that’s right？ Is something weird about it？」
Because I’d brought her back without a moment to clean up, the room was a total disaster.

name: Miyako
message: 「It’s a huge mess.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, there are just a few little spots that aren't tidy, that's all!」
Miyako starts rummaging through the trash.

name: Momiji
message: 「W-Wait, wait, Miyako, it’s dirty, you shouldn't touch that...」

name: Miyako
message: 「If it’s dirty, why don’t you throw it away？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Guh！？ That’s... way too direct...」

name: Miyako
message: 「Suzaku Hyper... Sis, what is this？」

name: Momiji
message: 「That’s just juice！ An empty juice can！」

name: Miyako
message: 「Then what about this？ 'Accompaniment for an evening drink'...？」

name: Momiji
message: 「That’s dried squid! Just regular squid, it’s delicious, I swear!」
Ah, Miyako’s gaze... it stings...

name: Miyako
message: 「Did you just pretend to be a good girl when you were back home？」

name: Momiji
message: 「...Ah, yes.」
I couldn't really make any more excuses, so I admitted it.

name: Momiji
message: 「But you understand, right, Miyako!？ How suffocating it is to live under Father back at home!」

name: Miyako
message: 「I understand.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Finally freed from all that, living in a dorm with my own private room？ You’d get a little freedom too, wouldn’t you！」

name: Miyako
message: 「Mm-hmm.」

name: Momiji
message: 「So I just ended up being a bit self-indulgent, it’s not really that big of a deal, right！」

name: Miyako
message: 「I guess so.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Miyako... you get it？」

name: Miyako
message: 「Yeah, I know~」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ughhh, Miyako, you’re such a good girl~」
I give her a good, hearty head-pat.

name: Miyako
message: 「Momiji-onesan, you were always a slob to begin with.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Back home, you’d always eat your snacks in Nadeshiko-onesan’s room just so you wouldn't mess up your own.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Tha-that’s because I was sharing my snacks with Nadeshiko……」

name: Miyako
message: 「And it was always Nadeshiko-onesan who ended up cleaning up the trash.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Also, you’d trade lending her your manga for making her clean your room, right？」

name: Momiji
message: 「I-I bribed her so no one would find out, so how！？」

name: Miyako
message: 「Walls have eyes, you know~」
M-Miyako, what a terrifying child……！
I’d always thought Miyako had a sharp intuition, but to think she’d even see through my schemes…….

name: Momiji
message: 「Sigh…… you got me. I can’t hide anything from you, Miyako~」

name: Miyako
message: 「Hehehe~♪」
When I stroke her hair, Miyako smiles happily.

name: Momiji
message: 「Still, I get why you’re here, but I was surprised that Tsubaki ran away from home with you too.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Well, Tsubaki was crying and begging me to take her along.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ah, I see. Well, that can’t be helped, then~. Tsubaki is the cutest one in the house, after all~」

name: Miyako
message: 「……Am I not cute？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Oh my~, does Miyako want some affection from her big sister too~？」

name: Miyako
message: 「It’s not like that, but.」
Hehehe, Miyako is so cute when she acts all jealous like that.

name: Momiji
message: 「It’s okay, Miyako, you’re my precious little sister too. You’re super cute~」

name: Miyako
message: 「Fufu…… thank you.」

name: Momiji
message: 「But was it really okay for you to run away and drag Tsubaki along？ Did anything dangerous happen？」

name: Miyako
message: 「Yeah, nothing in particular happened.」

name: Miyako
message: 「I did run into a tanuki spirit on the way, but it was incredibly kind. It even showed me the way.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I-I see, is that so~……」
Miyako is what you’d call a psychic, possessing the ability of “spirit sight” which allows her to see Keyou directly.
Because of that, her psychoreactive level is abnormally high as well. That must be why Miyako ended up breaking the spirit sword.

name: Momiji
message: 「So, what’s it going to take for you to go back home, Miyako？」

name: Miyako
message: 「I won’t go back until Father does a dogeza.」

name: Momiji
message: 「D-dogeza, you say…… why not just forgive him if he gives a normal apology?」

name: Miyako
message: 「I don’t think he’s capable of a normal apology, though~」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, yeah…… that guy’s pride is just too high, isn’t it.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Exactly, and he wounded my pride too. That’s why I’ll never forgive him until he apologizes.」
*Sigh*, to think Miyako would be this stubborn…… she’s usually surprisingly obedient, though.

name: Miyako
message: 「Oh, that reminds me, Tsubaki said she wants to see your room, Momiji. Can I take a picture and send it to her？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Eeeeehh!？ No way, no, that’s absolutely not allowed!」

name: Miyako
message: 「Eh~, why not？」

name: Momiji
message: 「If you send it to Tsubaki, she’ll show it to Father without even thinking! Then the reality of how I live will be exposed to him!」

name: Miyako
message: 「If you’re worried about him finding out, you could just clean up……」

name: Momiji
message: 「Aaah, I don’t wanna hear it! Stop hitting me with common sense~!」

name: Miyako
message: 「You’re such a hopeless big sister……」

name: Momiji
message: 「Heh heh, how’s that? Had enough?」

name: Miyako
message: 「Anyway, if he finds out, you’ll be in trouble, right?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, so keep it a secret, okay？」

name: Miyako
message: 「I’ll have to think about that~」

name: Momiji
message: 「H-hey…… what do you mean ‘think about it,’ Miyako-chan？」

name: Miyako
message: 「It’s okay, I’ll keep quiet about it to Father.」

name: Momiji
message: 「I see, that’s a relief~」

name: Miyako
message: 「In exchange, give me money.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Pfft！ W-w-wait, you’re demanding a bribe！？」
I was a pretty precocious kid myself, but she just made a demand that easily took it a step further.

name: Miyako
message: 「You were bribing big sis Nadeshiko, weren't you? So I think you have to bribe me too.」

name: Miyako
message: 「I spent all my pocket money before I got here. So, I’m kinda hoping for some cash~」

name: Momiji
message: 「P-please, have mercy and just take half my pocket money...」

name: Miyako
message: 「Yay, woo-hoo！」
Aaaah, my pocket money...

name: Momiji
message: 「By the way, what are you planning to use the money for？」

name: Miyako
message: 「I’m thinking of taking a tour around the school and checking out various things.」

name: Momiji
message: 「A tour? Does that mean you’re going to enroll in Murakumo Academy too, Miyako?」

name: Miyako
message: 「Hmm, if there are lots of strong people here, maybe. Is there anyone at this school stronger than you, big sis Momiji？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, let’s see... there’s at least one person, yeah.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Really？ How strong is that person？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Super, super strong.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Whoa, I really want to meet them！」

name: Momiji
message: （Hmm, so Miyako wants to meet strong people, huh.）

name: Miyako
message: 「Hey, hey big sis, can I meet that strong person？ I really want to see them.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, you actually just met him earlier. The tall guy who was with me is the one.」

name: Miyako
message: 「Is that the guy who was screaming at the top of his lungs about how much he loves kids？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ah... that’s definitely a police-interrogation-worthy case right there~」
...What is that teacher spouting off about?

name: Miyako
message: 「I see... so that guy is that strong, huh~！」

name: Miyako
message: 「Hey big sis, I want to have a match with that guy！」

name: Momiji
message: 「U-Umm, that has nothing to do with my job as a teacher, you know」

name: Miyako
message: 「Should I tell Father about this room？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Okay, I understand, I'll see what I can do！」

name: Miyako
message: 「I'm counting on you, Big Sis Momiji」
Ugh, to think the day would come when I'd be blackmailed by my own little sister... How did it come to this！？
